## Endpoints

### Data Read (3)
- `GET /api/v3/booking/widget/data` — Retrieve booking widget data.
- `GET /api/v3/doctors/{doctorId}/addresses/{addressId}/slots` — Get available time slots for a doctor's address.
- `GET /api/v3/patient-chat/doctor/{doctorId}/has-chat-enabled` — Check if doctor has chat enabled.

### Media (2)
- `GET /scripttemplates/202505.2.0/assets/otCenterRounded.json` — Get rounded center media asset.
- `GET /scripttemplates/202505.2.0/assets/v2/otPcCenter.json` — Get PC center media asset.

### Core API (1)
- `GET /j.php` — Fetch paginated feed updates.

## About This Skill

This skill provides access to Znanylekarz Pl's internal API — the hidden endpoints that power their web/mobile app.
These are NOT official public APIs. They were captured by observing network traffic while using the site.

**Important:**
- Auth tokens in `auth.json` may expire — re-capture if you get 401 errors
- Internal APIs can change without notice — endpoints may break
- Rate limits are unknown — be conservative with request frequency

## When to Use This Skill

Use this skill when you need to:
- Access Znanylekarz Pl data without official API access
- Automate actions on www.znanylekarz.pl (faster than browser automation)
- Call the same endpoints the Znanylekarz Pl frontend uses

